com.vector.cfg.workflow.diff.groovy.projectcompare.automerge

Interface IConfigureApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IConfigureApi
    IConfigureApi is the entry point for auto-merge related settings.
    To configure the automatic merge related settings the IConfigureApi is used. It allows to make detailed settings for the comparison. Also it allows to set the conflict resolution strategy when resolving the differences.

      • DONT_SOLVE

        @PublishedField
static final EConflictResolutionApproach DONT_SOLVE
        DONT_SOLVE
        describes a global conflict resolution approach where no conflicted differences are resolved.

      • ECUC_ECUEX_DEV_WS

        @PublishedField
static final EComparisonScope ECUC_ECUEX_DEV_WS
        ECUC_ECUEX_DEV_WS
        describes the scope in which ECUC, Extract of System Description and DaVinci Developer Workspace relevant data is compared.

      • ECUC_ECUEX_ONLY

        @PublishedField
static final EComparisonScope ECUC_ECUEX_ONLY
        ECUC_ECUEX_ONLY
        describes the scope in which only ECUC and Extract of System Description relevant data is compared (no comparison of DaVinci Developer Workspace).

      • USE_MINE

        @PublishedField
static final EConflictResolutionApproach USE_MINE
        USE_MINE
        describes a global conflict resolution approach where conflicted differences are resolved by using the value of project MINE.

      • USE_OTHER

        @PublishedField
static final EConflictResolutionApproach USE_OTHER
        USE_OTHER
        describes a global conflict resolution approach where conflicted differences are resolved by using the value of project OTHER.

      • moduleToMerge

        @PublishedMethod
void moduleToMerge(java.lang.String moduleShortName)
        Module configurations to merge
        moduleToMerge(String) adds the module configuration identified by the given short name to the collection of the modules to be considered for the merge. This will restrict the default selection behavior.
        Parameters:
        moduleShortName - the short name of the module configuration to merge.

      • setCompareEcuExtract

        @PublishedMethod
void setCompareEcuExtract(boolean consider)
        ECU Extract of System Description
        setCompareEcuExtract(boolean) activates or disables the comparison of the ECU Extract of System Description. true when extract should be compared. Otherwise false.
        Parameters:
        consider - true to enable comparison of the ECU Extract of System Description. Otherwise false.

      • setDisableUuidsForObjectIdentification

        @PublishedMethod
void setDisableUuidsForObjectIdentification(boolean value)
        UUID object identification
        #setDisableUuidsForObjectIdentification(Path) disables or enables the UUID usage for the object identification during comparison. In case of true the UUID usage will be disabled (this is the default behavior). If false the UUID will be used for object identification.
        Parameters:
        value - when true the UUID usage will be disabled (default). If false the UUID usage will be enabled.

      • setProjectBase

        @PublishedMethod
void setProjectBase(java.nio.file.Path projectBase)
        BASE
        setProjectBase(Path) is used to set the absolute path to project BASE which is used for comparison and to determine how a possible difference can be auto resolved.
        Parameters:
        projectBase - the project BASE used for comparison.

      • setProjectOther

        @PublishedMethod
void setProjectOther(java.nio.file.Path projectOther)
        OTHER
        setProjectOther(Path) is used to set the absolute path to project OTHER which is used for comparison with project MINE.
        Parameters:
        projectOther - the project OTHER used for comparison.
